svg.text: An event stream is a durable, append-only, immutable log: producers append at the tail, consumers start at the head (or any offset) and read at their own rate.
Per partition: ordered, indexed by an immutable offset. In Fig 2-1 new events were appended at offset 5 (partition 0) and 7 (partition 1);
instance 1, at offset 4, still has 5, 6 and 7 to process. A new consumer can start from the head and replay everything (partition 2 length illustrative).
